newsitem.title: USA: Iowa gov signs $22 mln of property tax cut credits.
newsitem.headline: Iowa gov signs $22 mln of property tax cut credits.

text.p: Iowa Gov. Terry Branstad has approved $22 million of fully funded property tax credits to local governments for fiscal 1998.
Branstad signed the tax credits bill Thursday, approving the third and final portion of tax relief in the $4.3 billion general fund budget passed by lawmakers in late April, his office announced.
Branstad had earlier signed into law an across-the-board income tax cut of $200 million and elimination of the inheritance tax on family members totalling $46 million.
